title: KP 57.4 aquifer thickness D_aq: evidence for the correction from 7 m to 12 m
definition: D_aq_m = combined A_g + N_s thickness to the K_1p base (provenance section 2; original thesis tab:strat_thickness)

sources.report: OYO (1999) 平成10年度 十勝川中流部堤防強化対策検討業務 報告書（調査・解析編）: Figs. 4-1-1 to 4-1-4 (PDF pp. 34 to 37, 1:200), text printed pp. 34 to 35 (PDF 39 to 40), longitudinal soil profile (PDF p. 247, H 1:10000, V 1:400)
sources.sheets: docs/references/R0xx.xxx/ 様式-3 (transverse panel), 様式-4 (soil-test table, no layer depths), 様式-5 (seepage model and soil constants)

orientation: Every figure, 様式-3 panel and 様式-5 model draws the river on the left (high-water-bed width, mean riverbed and HWL marker on the left); the right-hand boring is the landside-toe boring: B-2 (57.4), B-4 (58.8), B-6 (60.0), B-9 (62.0).
method: PyMuPDF render at 4 px/pt; EL calibrated on each drawing's own 10 m grid lines (1:200, 56.7 px/m, residual < 0.05 m); layer classes by nearest legend-swatch colour of the same figure, smoothed over 0.25 m; 様式-5 model lines as dark-pixel runs on axes calibrated from their own ticks (22.8 px/m). Precision: +/-0.1 m on a drawn line, +/-0.3 m on a boundary read beside a boring. Scripts and raw output in the thesis campaign artifacts (session5b_kp57/readings/).

KP57.4.layers: 3 cohesive 1.6E-04; 4 Ag sand-gravel 3.0E-01; 5 Ns sand-gravel 3.0E-01 (N=45); 6 volcanic ash 8.0E-05 (N=50) cm/s

KP60.0.layers: 5 Ag 1.0E-01; 6 gravel 1.0E-01 (N=40) to the model base; no ash layer

KP1.8R-1.position: Satsunai KP 1.8 right-bank crest, about 0.9 km downstream of KP 57.4

decision.rule: owner-chosen mean over the seepage path (riverside toe 10.3, crest 12.5, landside toe 13.35; mean 12.05; Form 5 model 11.9), integer like the other rows

effect_measured_before_decision: thesis campaign artifact session5b_kp57/a5_daq_effect.json (same seed, D_aq mean only; baseline bit-identical to production)

config_hashes.other_six: unchanged and equal to their persisted sweeps
